Test Description:
Verify that the number of data rows picked up from the SFTP file equals the rows BlackLine shows as imported.

1. Download the processed source file (pre-encryption sample copy). 
2. Count data rows (exclude header/footer). 
3. In BlackLine, open System › Jobs › Job Status → Details to view the “Records Imported” figure. 
4. Capture screenshots.
Expected Results: “Records Imported” matches source row count; job displays Completed with no errors .

Test Description:
Confirm that the aggregate monetary amount in BlackLine equals the total in the SFTP file.

1. Sum the value column(s) in the source file. 
2. Export a quick query or run a report on the imported table in BlackLine. 
3. Compare totals (Excel or SQL).
Expected Results: Aggregate amounts agree; any variance = 0.00. BlackLine implementation guide recommends post-import data validation of this type .

Test Description:
Ensure every required field defined in the import definition populated correctly.

1. Open the import definition and note mandatory columns. 
2. Run a simple IS NULL (or filter) query on the imported data source. 
3. Sample-test a few records in the UI.
Expected Results: No nulls or placeholder values in mandatory columns; column sequence & naming comply with definition rules .
